executiveSummaryText: This report presents the greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions inventory for the reporting period, calculated following the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard. Emissions are categorized into Scope 1 (direct), Scope 2 (indirect from energy), and Scope 3 (value chain) emissions.
scope1Description: Direct GHG emissions from sources owned or controlled by the organization.
scope2Description: Indirect GHG emissions from the generation of purchased electricity, steam, heating, and cooling.
scope3Description: All other indirect GHG emissions that occur in the organization's value chain.
methodologyText: This emissions inventory was prepared in accordance with the Greenhouse Gas Protocol Corporate Standard developed by the World Resources Institute (WRI) and the World Business Council for Sustainable Development (WBCSD).
scope1Detail: Direct greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from sources owned or controlled by your organization, such as company vehicles, on-site fuel combustion, or manufacturing activities.
scope2Detail: Indirect GHG emissions from the generation of purchased electricity, steam, heating, and cooling consumed by your organization.
scope3Detail: Other indirect GHG emissions that occur in the value chain of your organization, both upstream and downstream (including suppliers and product use by customers).
scope2Examples: Purchased electricity for offices and factories

onboarding.title: Inventory onboarding
onboarding.subtitle: Benchmark O1 · Smart Village
onboarding.description: Open one reporting period. Enter Smart Village electricity and Smart Village diesel, or record the gap. Leave South Valley, Abu Qir, and Alamein declared or excluded. This page does not submit a footprint. The period named here is the open data-entry period. Smart Village electricity and generator diesel from 1 Jul 2023 to 30 Jun 2024 stay on that closed year. A missing stream is not 0 kg.
onboarding.loadFailed: The onboarding checklist could not be loaded.
onboarding.emptyDescription: Onboarding needs exactly one reporting period with status open. Draft, locked, and closed periods do not count. Open the period after the boundary is named.
onboarding.openPeriodMet: One open period: {{name}}. Start {{start}} is before end {{end}}. Type {{type}}.
onboarding.openPeriodDates: One period is open ({{name}}) but the start date is not before the end date.
onboarding.openPeriodCount: {{count}} reporting periods are open. Onboarding allows exactly one.
onboarding.tooManyOpen: Onboarding allows exactly one open reporting period. The next legal action on an extra open period is Lock, not Close. This page does not lock it.
onboarding.tooManyOpenHint: The checklist stopped. It did not invent a kilogram.
onboarding.openPeriodType: The open period {{name}} is {{period_type}}. O1 requires annual.
onboarding.boundaryMissing: The open period has no organizational boundary.

onboarding.sourceCovered: {{name}} is covered for this period, with linked tables.

onboarding.scope2MethodUnlabelled: {{name}} is Scope 2 and has no location-based or market-based method.

onboarding.kgFromSummary: {{kg}} kg CO2e, scope {{scope}}{{methodLabel}}, from the calculation summary.

onboarding.otherCampus: {{name}} is {{status}} and is outside benchmark O1.
onboarding.otherCampusAbsent: {{name}} has no inventory source. It is absent, not zero.
onboarding.otherCampusNoStatus: {{name}} has a source and no status on this period.
onboarding.otherCampusDeclared: {{name}} is declared. It is not part of passing O1.
onboarding.otherCampusExcludedNotes: {{name}} is excluded as other, and the notes are empty.

onboarding.otherCampusCovered: {{name}} is marked covered. That does not open South Valley, Abu Qir, or Alamein benchmarks.
onboarding.factorMissing: No active emission factor for {{name}}, scope {{scope}}, unit {{unit}}. Onboarding does not invent one.
onboarding.factorInactive: {{name}} (id {{id}}) matches scope {{scope}} unit {{unit}}, and it is inactive.
onboarding.factorCountry: {{name}} (id {{id}}) has country code {{country_code}}. Onboarding accepts EGY or a blank code.
onboarding.coverageGoalAbsent: Both Smart Village sources exist, and there is no coverage goal with scope 1+2.
onboarding.coverageGoalCompleteness: Coverage goal {{name}} (id {{id}}) uses {{completeness}}. Onboarding requires materiality_bounded.
onboarding.coverageGoalTier: Coverage goal {{name}} (id {{id}}) has minimum tier {{tier}}. Onboarding requires 4.
onboarding.coverageGoalStatus: Coverage goal {{name}} (id {{id}}) is {{status}}. Onboarding requires draft.
onboarding.coverageGoalMet: Coverage goal {{name}} (id {{id}}) is draft, scope 1+2, materiality bounded, minimum tier 4, target year {{target_year}}.
onboarding.stepBoundaryHint: Consolidation approach must be equity share, financial control, or operational control.
onboarding.stepPeriodHint: Exactly one period with status open. Start date before end date. Annual for O1.
onboarding.stepSourcesHint: Smart Village electricity, scope 2. Smart Village diesel, scope 1.
onboarding.stepFactorsHint: Electricity uses kWh. Diesel uses litre. The factor is a record, not a typed number.
onboarding.stepActivityHint: Quantity above zero. A missing month is a gap, not a zero.
onboarding.stepCalculateHint: A person confirms the run. Chat does not start it.
onboarding.stepCoverHint: Covered needs linked tables on this period. Other campuses use insufficient data, not silence.
onboarding.stepQuoteHint: Chat may repeat a figure only when this turn's calculation summary contains it. Otherwise say the period is opening.
onboarding.closedLeavesTitle: Closed leaves. Inventory kilograms are absent on this panel. Missing is not 0 kg.
onboarding.closedO2: South Valley stays closed. Discovered file south_valley_scope12_fy2526.csv quotes electricity 700000 kWh, generators 25000 L, and mobile diesel 125500 L. That file is fy2526 and names both diesel streams, so it is not calculated. File south_valley_inventory.csv is absent. Inventory kilograms are absent.
onboarding.closedO3: Abu Qir stays closed. Discovered files abu_qir_monthly_electricity_fy2526.csv and abu_qir_fuel_fy2526.csv. June electricity is blank. Diesel is not labelled generators or fleet. File abu_qir_inventory.csv is absent. Inventory kilograms are absent.
onboarding.closedO4: New Alamein stays closed. File new_alamein_inventory.csv is absent. Required columns: campus, source_name, scope, activity_unit, quantity, stream, period_start, period_end. Inventory kilograms are absent.
onboarding.closedO5: Category 5 waste stays closed. smart_village_inventory_fy2324.csv quotes Waste Disposal 73.0 ton. File smart_village_waste_factor.csv is absent. 73.0 ton is activity, not a calculation. Inventory kilograms are absent.
onboarding.closedS2: Market-based Scope 2 is absent. No distinct contractual factor. This is not zero and not an Egypt residual mix.
onboarding.closedP1: Assurance stays closed. not_assured is unmet until assurer name, engagement type, ISO 14064-3, opinion date, and statement id are all present.
onboarding.closedP2: Disclosure export status is shape_only. It maps existing ledger fields to ESRS E1-6, IFRS S2, and CDP C6. It is not a filing.

chairman.title: Chairman Dashboard
chairman.description: Platform-wide strategic overview — footprint, coverage, SBTi alignment, and open actions. Audience: board and leadership. For day-to-day tracking use Emissions Breakdown.

chairman.footprintTip: Headline total excludes market-based Scope 2. Scope 2 in this total is location-based. Market-based is not added.
chairman.coverageTip: Sources with at least one calculation divided by declared sources.

chairman.actionsTip: Work items for coverage gaps. This page does not close them.

chairman.noTrajectory: No trajectory data. SBTi targets are required.
